sections.title: The Reality Check: n=6
animations: Highlight \"Patterns look like doubling powers.\" in #FFFFFF. Show sequence 1, 2, 4, 8, 16.
Highlight \"Wait, check six points.\" in #FFFFFF. Show 6 points on a in #FFFFFF.
Highlight \"The total is thirty-one.\" in #FFFFFF. Display 31 distinct regions in #FF5733.

sections.title: The True Mathematical Pattern
lecture_lines: Regions equal C(n,4) plus C(n,2) plus one.
animations: Highlight \"Powers of two fail here.\" in #FFFFFF. Display \"16!= 31\" in #FF3333 using.
Highlight \"Use Euler's characteristic instead.\" in #FFFFFF. Fade in formula: R = binom(n,4) + binom(n,2) + 1.
Highlight \"The formula is a sum.\" in #FFFFFF. Show terms binom(n,4) and binom(n,2) in #FF5733.
Highlight \"Regions equal C(n,4) plus C(n,2) plus one.\" in #FFFFFF. Substitute n=6.
Highlight \"This works for all n.\" in #FFFFFF. Display result 31 in #33FF57 using.

sections.title: Conclusion & Takeaway
animations: Highlight \"Data can deceive our eyes.\" in #FFFFFF. Display \"Deceptive Patterns\" in #FF5733.
